what.text: This page follows refugees from Gambia living in Italy, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1493 Gambian refugees in Italy, 22.2% of all refugees from Gambia.
Germany hosts the most Gambian refugees, followed by Italy, the United States and France.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Gambia, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2016 to 2019.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2001 at 12 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 12968, at the end of 2019, and was much lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Italy.
These are year-end totals for Italy only, reported to UNHCR.
